source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιος Μωυσής ο Αναχωρητής»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page says only that the venerable Moses the anchorite died in peace, with no country, no century and no year, so he is told from the corpus's eleven other Moseses by the day alone, which is why the slug and the display name carry it; none of them is kept on 28 June in any calendar. The epithet «ο Αναχωρητής» is recorded in `types` as hermit, the nearest the corpus's vocabulary holds, since anchorite is not one of its values. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
